chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from al-Husayn, from Ibn Yahya al-Kazzaz, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him)
That he disliked eating the crow because it is a sinner (fasiq).
ai.seo_question: Why did Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq dislike eating crows?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prohibited eating the crow based on the attribute of being 'fasiq' (transgressor), a classification in Shia jurisprudence that links moral or behavioral impurity to ritual purity. This ruling highlights the unique Shia emphasis on the intrinsic nature of the animal, distinguishing it from the general Sunni view which often relies on the animal's classification as 'khabith' (impure) or its specific hunting characteristics.
